No facility ban or criminalisation survives (2016 law repealed 2017), but no statewide non-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, birth-certificate rules retain original marker, and care/sports bans. Undercount violence figure unusable. Above parent mean.

Most-Protective tier: public-accommodations and employment protection, hate-crime coverage incl. gender identity, panic defence abolished, shield law for care, no facility ban. Still subject to parent's hostile passport, entry-screening and custody regimes.

Most-Protective tier with shield law, public-accommodations ban, strengthened hate-crime law, M/F/X documents, and — decisively — custody by recognised gender including strip searches and housing. Parent passport and entry regimes still apply.

March 2025 facility law with private cause of action reaches all multi-occupancy restrooms, changing and sleeping quarters — universal exposure — plus no state non-discrimination or hate-crime law, surgical birth-certificate rule, listed among worst states.
